topic: Quilez-Wright SDF cone-traced soft shadow penumbra ratio vs hard sphere-traced binary umbra rig
topic_zh: Quilez-Wright 有向距离场（SDF）单射线锥比软阴影对比朴素二值球追踪刀切黑边
scope: Deterministic Inigo Quilez & Daniel Wright (SIGGRAPH 2015 UE4/UE5 Distance Field Soft Shadows) single-ray cone-aperture penumbra integration (u = clamp(0.5 + 0.5*k*d_min/t, 0, 1), S = u^2*(3 - 2u)) versus naive binary sphere-traced hard shadows (d_min > 0 ? 1 : 0) and 64-ray distributed area-light disk quadrature across 17 closest-approach stations (d_min in [-1.60m, +1.60m]). No neural shadow denoising execution.

protocol.function: u = clamp(0.5 + 0.5 · k · d_min / t, 0, 1), S = u²(3 − 2u) → Boundary S(0.00m) = 0.5000 (0.0000 Penumbra Error)

robustness.name: Sampled 17 closest-approach SDF stations reconstruct exact C1 area-light penumbra from 1 ray march

good_fit: UE5 Mesh Distance Field Soft Shadows, Shadertoy/WebGPU ray-marched SDF scenes, and global distance-field skylight occlusion
Rendering contact-hardening soft shadows (sharp at t → 0, wide penumbra at large t) using only 1 ray march per pixel
Tracking min_t(k · d_SDF(P + t·L) / t) at zero extra SDF evaluation cost inside the sphere-tracing loop
Replacing noisy 16–64 ray stochastic area-light shadow sampling and temporal denoisers
not_for: Non-SDF triangle soup meshes without precomputed Mesh Distance Fields or analytical SDF primitives
Pinhole point lights in vacuum with zero angular radius (k → ∞)
Neural screen-space shadow synthesis or spatiotemporal SVGF denoising
